mapper.insert: MERGE INTO approval AS target USING (VALUES (#{a_date}, #{a_type}, #{a_gu}, #{a_bgo})) AS source (a_date, a_type, a_gu, a_bgo) ON target.a_date = source.a_date AND target.a_type = source.a_type WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.a_gu = source.a_gu, target.a_bgo = source.a_bgo WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (a_date, a_type, a_gu, a_bgo) VALUES (source.a_date, source.a_type, source.a_gu, source.a_bgo);
